units.orientation: source mesh yaw, Y up; no billboard or facing applied
units.pivot: source bounds centre on x and z, minimum y
units.metres_per_unit: multiply by a model's metres_per_unit to recover source metres

layout.position: u16 x3, decoded with bounds.origin and quant_scale
layout.uv: u16 x2, IEEE half floats, V origin top-left
layout.alpha: albedo alpha is constant; textures are decoded opaque

key_spare.title: Spare Key
key_spare.note: Old-key model; the RPD spare key shares the same simple key shape.

fuse_main.title: Fuse (Main Hall)
fuse_main.note: Glass cartridge fuse; its albedo is labelled Main Hall and Break Room hallway shutter.

jack_handle.title: Mechanic Jack Handle
jack_handle.note: Jack driver head plus grip; the drivergrip mesh alone ships with a black debug material.

red_jewel.title: Red Jewel
red_jewel.note: Shared Env_Jewelry master material; tinted red in the manifest.

board_wood.title: Wooden Boards
board_wood.note: Loose board from the set dressing library; the pickup is a stack of identical boards.

upgrade_speed_loader.title: Speed Loader (SLS 60)
upgrade_speed_loader.note: Lady Smith power-up part; the speed loader is the same small cylinder part.

hip_pouch.title: Hip Pouch
hip_pouch.note: Claire's side pack model; the hip pouch shares the pouch silhouette.

jewelry_box.title: Jewelry Box
jewelry_box.note: Shared Env_Jewelry material is tinted by a JewelryColor parameter that this pack does not evaluate, so the box renders neutral metal.

file_letter.title: Letter
file_letter.note: Sewer Co pamphlet paper sheet reused as the letter silhouette.
